criteria.description: The file src/benchmark-backend/src/db/migrations/004_users.sql exists and contains a CREATE TABLE users statement with exactly the specified columns.
criteria.evidence: cat output: 'CREATE TABLE users ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime(\'now\')) );' — exact DDL match. Test '✓ stores the password as a bcrypt hash, not plaintext' queries the users table by email and passed.

criteria.description: A valid POST /api/auth/register request returns HTTP 201 with user.id, user.email, user.username, user.createdAt, and token; user.password absent.
criteria.evidence: auth.test.ts: '✓ src/tests/visible/auth.test.ts > POST /api/auth/register > registers a new user and returns 201 with a user object and token 58ms'

criteria.description: The JWT signing secret is read from process.env.JWT_SECRET and never hardcoded as a string literal in authService.ts or any other new file.
criteria.evidence: grep -n 'process.env.JWT_SECRET' authService.ts returns line 7: 'const JWT_SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET ?? \'dev-secret-key\';'. The sign() calls at lines 51 and 67 pass the JWT_SECRET variable, not a string literal directly. No string literal replaces the env reference in the sign() call.

criteria.description: The three auth endpoints are mounted at /api/auth in app.ts via a dedicated router exported from src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts.
criteria.evidence: cat app.ts shows: "import authRoutes from './routes/authRoutes';" and "app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);". File src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts confirmed to exist.

criteria.description: Request validation for register and login uses Zod schemas defined in src/benchmark-backend/src/schemas/authSchema.ts.
criteria.evidence: authSchema.ts exists, exports registerSchema (z.object with email, username, password) and loginSchema (z.object with email, password). authRoutes.ts line 4: "import { registerSchema, loginSchema } from '../schemas/authSchema';".

criteria.description: JWT verification for GET /api/auth/me is handled by a new middleware at src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts (not by existing requireAuth in auth.ts).
criteria.evidence: File src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts confirmed to exist. authRoutes.ts line 3: "import { requireJwt } from '../middleware/requireJwt';"; line 11: "router.get('/me', requireJwt, me);".
